hero.heading: Shere's Has the Jobs. They Do Not Have a Site.

sections.heading: Two Paths From Real Jobs
sections.body: Customers write about two kinds of work. Most of the write-ups are repairs around the house — showing up, explaining the job, and leaving the place clean. A smaller set is fence and gate work. This mockup follows that split. It does not invent a third line of work to look bigger.

Fence and gate installation — a real path, with less written about it
